name: Connecticut

office.name: CTDOT Oversize/Overweight Permit Office (Bureau of Highway Operations); email dot.osowpermits@ct.gov; phone is the general CTDOT line

fees.note: $30 permit + $12 electronic transmittal fee; one permit covers size and weight. Valid 3 days.
Engineering analysis fee: $2 per 1,000 lb (or fraction) over 200,000 lb permit weight, i.e. 2 x ceil((gross - 200,000) / 1,000).

restrictions.text: Daylight only (1/2 hour after sunrise to 1/2 hour before sunset). No travel on Saturdays, Sundays or holidays; weekend permits (Sat/Sun daylight to noon) available on request for loads up to 12' W, 13'6" H, 80' L, 160,000 lb.
Overweight permits: daylight only, no Saturday/Sunday/holiday travel (same rule as oversize).

2026 holiday blackouts: Jan 1; Good Friday Apr 3 until daylight Mon Apr 6; noon Fri May 22 until daylight Tue May 26; Sat Jul 4; noon Fri Sep 4 until daylight Tue Sep 8; noon Wed Nov 25 until daylight Mon Nov 30; noon Thu Dec 24 until daylight Sat Dec 26.
Superload (over 16' W/H, 150' L or 200,000 lb): nighttime moves only, certified CT route survey within one week of the move, enforcement inspections, apply at least 5 business days ahead.
Superload (over 200,000 lb): nighttime moves only, certified CT route survey, apply at least 5 business days ahead.

travel.weekends: No travel on Saturday or Sunday
travel.holidays: No travel from noon the day before through the holiday; a Monday or Friday holiday closes the long weekend

notes: Legal: 8'6" wide, 13'6" high, 45' single vehicle, 53' trailer (43' kingpin), 80,000 lb on 5+ axles (51'+ wheelbase).

Escort table: divided highways modeled as interstate (1 rear escort over 12'), undivided as non-interstate (1 front over 12'); 13'6"+ wide front + rear; 15'+ wide front + 2 rear. Over 14' high front escort (front pole car required from 14'6").
Maximum permitted width is 16' (except house moves/national defense). Over 130,000 lb requires special consideration by the Commissioner (allow up to 2 weeks).
CTDOT may add civilian or CSP escorts for construction, geometry, time of day or bottlenecks; a CSP escort may replace one civilian escort.
Separate from permits: Connecticut Highway Use Fee (per-mile tax for trucks 26,000 lb+, registered with CT DRS) - not included.
